title: Dream Studio grader verdict — falsification role
description: The falsification analyst's I/O contract (WO-FALSIFY-FIRST-PASS). A conformant provider enumerates the worst reachable states for the change and classifies each scenario COVERED / PROPOSED / UNVERIFIED, so 'what should have been tested and wasn't' is answered by construction rather than left silent. falsification_score is the role's own score: 1.0 when no scenario is UNVERIFIED or error-severity PROPOSED. Extra fields are allowed. Like every other role contract, ONLY the role's own score is required (the repo-wide invariant guarded by test_each_role_schema_requires_its_own_score): an empty scenarios array would satisfy a required-check anyway, so requiring it bought nothing — the enumeration expectation lives in the prompt, and the scenarios shape is validated here when present.

scenario_class.description: One of the taxonomy classes: crash_mid_write, race_between_writers, version_skew, partial_failure, malformed_input, interrupted_io, reachability_vs_config, empty_absent_state.
